#QAEngineer #HealthTech #TestAutomation #BDD #APITesting #Selenium #Python  

QA Engineer at HealthTech Innovations Inc. – turning chaos into clarity, one test case at a time. 🚀  
I’m the guy who turns “this isn’t working” into “it’s fixed and scalable.” With a knack for spotting edge cases before they hit production, I’ve spent years making sure healthtech systems don’t just *work* but *trustworthy*.  

When I’m not writing test scripts, I’m probably debugging APIs or optimizing automation frameworks. Python and REST APIs are my go-to tools for slicing through complexity, while Selenium and Playwright keep me in the driver’s seat for browser-based chaos. BDD and TDD? They’re not just buzzwords—they’re my workflow.  

I’ve built test suites that slash regression time by 40% and automated workflows that save teams 200+ hours annually. My focus? Making sure every line of code in healthtech meets the bar for precision and reliability.  

Looking to collaborate with engineers who want to build systems that *actually* work? Let’s connect and crush the next big thing. 💥
